Part of #295 / #257. Currently `"none"` in `configs/pyrightconfig.json`. Probed with pyright 1.1.414 by setting the rule to `"warning"`.

**2178 findings in 286 files** (app: 1904, tests: 174, components: 84, scripts: 14, cli: 1, rxconfig.py: 1). Likely dominated by untyped Reflex APIs in `app`. Also very slow: the probe run took many minutes. Decide whether to restore for a subset (e.g. exclude `app`) or keep at `"none"` and document why. Tackle after the other three.
conductor/issue-325

input.command: gh issue view 325 --comments | tail -30; grep -n -B3 -A3 reportUnknownMemberType configs/pyrightconfig.json; git log --oneline -3 -- configs/pyrightconfig.json

result.output: - **\"Restore for a subset\" is expressible** — `executionEnvironments` supports per-subtree diagnostic overrides. `{\"root\": \"app\", \"reportUnknownMemberType\": \"none\"}` alongside the rule at `\"error\"` globally restores the rule everywhere except `app` without dropping `app` from type-checking. - **`exclude: [\"app\"]` is not the tool for this** — trunk passes each file to pyright explicitly, and explicitly-listed targets are analyzed regardless of `exclude`; it would only change batch-mode enumeration. - **Gate mechanics:** a config-only flip passes Trunk Check (the upstream base scan runs with HEAD's config, so the flood is grandfathered), but it landmines the next PR touching any still-violating file. `\"warning\"` silences nothing under trunk (warning findings still fail the new-issue scan) — the end state must be `\"error\"` or `\"none\"`. **Suggested plan:** 1. Land #322/#323/#324 first (as the issue says), then **re-baseline** — counts move as sibling sweeps land; never plan from today's 2178. 2. Re-probe with the pinned pyright + venv wiring, chunked per top-level dir (background the big `app/` chunks; `app/www/style.py` alone can run >12 min). Split findings app vs non-app. 3. Fix the non-app residue (~274 today: tests 174, components 84, scripts 14, cli 1, rxconfig 1) using the repo's established idioms — typed wrappers at Reflex `Var`/`Component` boundaries, annotated locals, 2-arg `getattr` for Reflex-internal reads, `# pyright: ignore[reportUnknownMemberType]` with reason only where Reflex's stubs are wrong. 4. Restore at `\"error\"` with an `executionEnvironments` carve-out for `app` if its count stays dominant; document the carve-out in the config (pyrightconfig.json tolerates JSONC comments — verify with the pinned version) referencing this issue. If the re-probe shows app collapsed too, restore globally. 5. Fallback: keep `\"none\"` with a documented rationale if app's surface is dominated by genuinely untyped Reflex internals with no cheap shim — revisit on Reflex upgrades. Recommendation: plan for the carve-out restore — it is the only option that restores non-app coverage while keeping the gate landmine-free for `app`.   ｜ [Implement a fix ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/325?action=build) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/elviskahoro/buridan-ui/actions/runs/42085668492/job/127449966333) ｜ via [Pullfrog](https://pullfrog.com) ｜ Using `glm-5p3-flash` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai) -- author: elviskahoro association: owner edited: false status: none -- Analysis of the 2178 findings (all 'partially unknown' / 'unknown'): - **~2060 (95%) are Reflex stub noise**: `rx.el.div` (888), `p` (288), `span` (108), chart builders, `.render`, `.value`, `set_value`, etc. Reflex's element factories carry `...`/unknown parts in their signatures, so these are not fixable in this repo. - **~130 are real**, mostly bare `list.append`/`sort` on untyped lists (`app/utils/routes.py`, `app/www/*`), plus tests (98) and scripts (14). These mostly stem from unannotated variables and likely shrink after #323/#324. **Recommendation:** keep `reportUnknownMemberType` at `"none"` (enabling it would need ~2000 suppressions or a blanket ignore, with no safety gain). Revisit after #323/#324 for `scripts`/`tests`/`cli` only, if pyright's per-environment rule overrides are worth the config complexity. Close this as 'won't restore' unless that follow-up is wanted. -- 22- "reportPrivateUsage": "warning", 23- "reportUnknownArgumentType": "none", 24- "reportUnknownLambdaType": "error", 25: "reportUnknownMemberType": "none", 26- "reportUnknownParameterType": "none", 27- "reportUnknownVariableType": "none", 28- "reportUntypedBaseClass": "error", 5e9d95d Strict typing for first-party code; promote two pyright rules to error (#300) 2efe952 Fix Pyright config path in Trunk (#148)
